messages.subject: About how install install_github('ramnathv/rCharts@dev')
parts:
Hello,

some one know how to install 'install_github('ramnathv/rCharts@dev')' in the https://www.shinyapps.io site?

I test my app in a Debian testing Box and is running smoothly. The unique difference I see is the version of rCharts.

=======

> require(shiny)
Loading required package: shiny
> runApp()
Loading required package: devtools
Loading required package: rCharts
Loading required package: twitteR
Loading required package: maps
Loading required package: geosphere
Loading required package: sp

Attaching package: 'geosphere'

The following object is masked from 'package:shiny':

    span

Loading required package: RColorBrewer
Loading required package: RCurl
Loading required package: bitops
Loading required package: base64enc

Listening on http://127.0.0.1:7252
Error in system.file("libraries", lib, package = package) :
  object 'package' not found
Error in system.file("libraries", lib, package = package) :
  object 'package' not found
Error in system.file("libraries", lib, package = package) :
  object 'package' not found


  C-c C-c
>
>
==============
>
> traceback()

4: Sys.sleep(0.001)
3: withCallingHandlers(expr, error = function(e) {
       handle <- getOption("shiny.error")
       if (is.function(handle))
           handle()
   })
2: shinyCallingHandlers(while (!.globals$stopped) {
       serviceApp()
       Sys.sleep(0.001)
   })
1: runApp()
>

Anyone have any idea?

Best!
Sergio
